integrity: The proof is mathematical, with a supplemental standalone finite exact/arithmetic checker; finite checks do not certify arbitrary times or almost-sure claims. No independent mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: For fixed dimension, independent fair face directions, coordinatewise current-length scaling. The stationary law is singular, so finite-time atomic marginals converge weakly but not in total variation. Other shape normalizations and joint dimension-time limits not studied. The general Bernoulli-IFS ingredients are classical; priority against uninspected literature is uncertain.
title: Cantor-dust occupation and recurrent normalized shapes in random Fibonacci block tilings
